CISF ASI Paramedical Staff PST Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) has released the PST Admit Card for the post of Paramedical Staff. This recruitment has been issued for 24 posts. The online application process for CISF ASI Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 June 2026, to 07 July 2026. The PST Exam Start From 04 September 2026. Candidates must download their CISF ASI Paramedical Staff PST Admit Card 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 June 2026
  • Last Date : 07 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 July 2026
  • PST Exam Date : 04 September 2026
  • PST Admit Card : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
